name: River — Calm
_doc: Stereo-friendly water soundscape. Uses the same brook clip pool as the forest scenes (so no new audio assets needed) but routes ONLY water — no wind, no leaves, no creatures. The result is a single continuous river-like wash, ideal as a focus/sleep noise cover. Authored for Stereo layout so it works on a single device or a single BT speaker; the bo-mux RouteStrategy::Auto handles upmix to Quad when multiple speakers are available.
_pairs_with: Any tonal residual the canceller leaves; broadband content fades naturally into this.

layers.name: brook_left
layers._doc: Brook clip pool routed to the LEFT channel. Gain centered around 0.75 with mild range — should sound like a steady river rather than a wave-pulsing recording.

layers.name: brook_right
layers._doc: Independent brook stream on the RIGHT channel. Using brook_mid clips (slightly different than brook_close) avoids the comb-filter effect of playing identical content on both sides — gives the river its width.

layers.name: river_bed
layers._doc: Low-frequency 'bed' of distant water + far brook — the foundation under the two close streams. Diffuse routing spreads it across whatever speakers are present, so it sounds like environmental space rather than coming from one direction.

description: Steady stereo water: a close babbling brook over a deeper river bed.
